entities.summary: Cristina Campo was the pen name of Vittoria Maria Angelica Marcella Cristina Guerrini, Italian writer, poet, and translator. She published under the pseudonyms Puccio Quaratesi, Bernardo Trevisano, Giusto Cabianca and Benedetto P. d'Angelo.
